entries.title: 天宫仙班压阵
entries.text:
Create one 16:9 high-end Chinese 3D CG animated-film keyframe.
CG craft requirements: visible 3D modeled forms, SSS translucent skin response, separated cloth/hair/metal/stone shaders, volumetric light, simulation-driven robes, hair, clouds, smoke, particles or water, and cinematic depth layers.
Topic family: 西游.
Aesthetic direction: 仙界秩序、云海天宫、神仙谱系和天兵天将阵列.
Shot scale: 极远景到中远景.
Composition diversity requirements: wide vertical-depth palace-cloud tableau; no single hero close-up; three readable depth bands: mortal challenger, heavenly army, high immortals.
Scene: a lone rebel pilgrim silhouette stands on a broken cloud stair while ranks of heavenly soldiers, banner-bearing generals and calm immortals arrange above a glowing palace gate.
Camera: low cloud-stair camera looking upward through drifting banners, letting the palace and army dwarf the foreground figure.
Blocking: foreground figure is small but tense, midground heavenly soldiers brace spears in curved ranks, background immortals hover still as the moral pressure.
Action physics: cloud stairs fracture under the rebel's foot, banners and sleeve tails stream toward the palace light, spear ranks compress inward before impact.
Event source: cloud stair rupture, divine banners, spear rank pressure, palace gate light and immortal robe wind.
Material behavior: cloud volume rolls in layered sheets, silk banners have cloth simulation, gold armor has restrained shader glints, skin uses soft SSS rim light.
Character design requirements: heavenly generals and immortals have distinct silhouettes, refined Chinese faces, elegant armor/robes and readable eyes, not identical faceless troops.
Lighting and spectacle: white-gold palace backlight, cyan cloud fill, warm skin bounce on faces, strong atmospheric god-rays through banners.
Single-frame event contract: the celestial order is closing before the first blow; the small rebel either breaks the gate or is erased by the whole heavenly system.
Guofeng identity requirements: Chinese body language, garment construction, object function, command hierarchy, immortal cosmology or battlefield order must carry the image.
Failure requirements: Avoid engineered devices, rotating parts, clockwork logic, gear shapes, industrial hard-surface spectacle, dominant jade surfaces, readable text, watermark, oil-paint concept-art surface, flat illustration, live-action skin pores and generic game-poster gloss.

entries.title: 莲火轮破阵
entries.text:

Creative focus: make the youthful divine warrior more clearly a designed Chinese CG asset; increase wheel/sash/beast interaction and reduce generic fantasy beast reading.
Scene: a lotus-born divine youth bursts downward through palace roof tiles, one fire wheel in extreme foreground, red silk sash physically cinching a bronze beast mask at the jaw hinge.
Aggressive camera: near-collision camera inside the spinning fire wheel, looking past ember spokes toward the warrior face and the captured bronze beast.
Character asset requirements: beautiful fierce Chinese youth with clear animated cheek planes, lotus-crown silhouette, expressive hand shapes and layered lotus armor, no photographic skin.
Event source: fire wheel, red silk sash, spear heat, lotus armor plates and bronze beast jaw mechanism.
Material behavior: fire particles orbit on two wheel planes, silk stretches under tension, bronze jaw heats and warps, roof tiles burst upward from pressure.
Lighting and spectacle: vermilion fire core below, blue-black night roof behind, hard rim on cheek and fingers, ember light through translucent sash.
Single-frame event contract: the sash has already locked the beast jaw while the spear is still descending; the next beat is capture or roof collapse.
High-burn requirements: first glance must read as a peak trailer shot, with strong silhouette, readable hands, expressive face, clear force line and a dangerous next beat.

entries.title: 壁画修复剑官
entries.text:
Create one wide 16:9 写实电影 Chinese character keyframe. This is a character-media transfer focus; the role design is locked and only the medium grammar changes.
Character consistency: the same role must remain recognizable across the target medium. Face structure, role function, garment construction, hands, role object and scene anchor stay locked; only the medium grammar changes.
Usable keyframe requirements: this must be one publishable 16:9 Chinese keyframe with a clear irreversible moment, readable eyes and hands, a visible role object, one scene anchor and no explanatory text.
Target medium requirements: Cinematography gate: live-action Chinese film still, photographic realism, real human proportions, credible lens perspective, natural skin and cloth response, motivated practical light and no illustration surface.
Medium execution language: cinematography: 35mm grounded medium close keyframe, real set depth, controlled practical light, natural shadow falloff, visible fabric weight and believable hand tension.
Role label: 年轻女性主角 / 仪式官兼剑修.
Role type: 正向主角.
Chinese aesthetic root: 明艳有度：矿物色的明亮不等于甜美，仪式秩序和剑意同时压在眉眼里。.
Identity and story function: 二十多岁的壁画修复官兼剑修，负责判断一幅活壁画是否应被封回墙内。.
Locked face and bone structure: oval Chinese face with defined cheekbone rhythm, focused almond eyes, firm mouth line, elegant but not doll-like, beauty carries responsibility.
Locked hair, crown, makeup or grooming: high coiled hair anchored by a small metal-and-silk ritual pin, restrained mineral-red lip, malachite eye-line only as ceremonial trace.
Locked garment construction: short outer mantle over a long narrow-sleeved robe, flying scarf controlled by belt tension, sword-cord integrated with ritual brush pouch.
Locked material and color system: lapis blue, malachite green, ochre gold and warm off-white, silk and mineral pigment dust visible.
Locked role object: ritual brush paused before an unfinished guardian eye and one sheathed short sword at the belt.
Locked posture and gesture: brush hand freezes one breath before touching pigment, other hand rests on the sword, torso turned toward the wall as if listening.
Locked scene anchor: one Dunhuang-inspired mineral wall plane with a single unfinished guardian eye.
Single-frame event contract: the mural eye shifts first, her brush stops before contact, and her sword hand decides whether the wall stays alive or is sealed.
Character consistency: after changing medium, the viewer must still recognize the same age, class, face structure, garment logic, role object and decision pressure.
Medium-specific failure requirements: no CG asset look, no flat animation line art, no anime line art, no painted concept art, no poster HDR, no glossy fantasy cosplay.
Common failure requirements: no default LLM face, no generic costume portrait, no web-influencer face, no caricatured Chinese face, no role swap, no unreadable role object, no ornate background overpowering the subject, no crowd, no readable text, no watermark.

entries.title: 破玉令的年轻修士
entries.text:
Create one wide 16:9 Chinese character design keyframe with a restrained scene anchor. Keep keep the character design dominant.
Character design: the important character must be designed before the final scene. Face structure, age signal, hair/crown/makeup/grooming, garment construction, material layers, posture, gesture and supporting light must all come from a Chinese aesthetic root, not from random default beauty.
Scene pairing: use only one restrained environment anchor and one role object so the character design remains the main focus; no complex action, no large VFX, no crowd, no ornate poster background.
Role type: 正向主角.
Character label: 年轻男性主角 / 修行者.
Chinese aesthetic root: 清骨藏锋：外表清俊克制，内在有未出鞘的决断，像晨光照在未磨完的玉上。.
Identity and story function: 二十岁出头的山门弟子，刚被推到门派危机前台；不是天生神仙，而是第一次必须承担后果的人。.
Face and bone structure: narrow but structured Chinese facial planes, calm brows with pressure at the inner corners, clear jaw but not square hero jaw, alert eyes with doubt under discipline.
Hair, crown, makeup or grooming: tied black hair with a simple dark jade hairpin, no loose idol waves, clean natural skin, one faint training scar near the knuckle rather than facial decoration.
Garment construction: layered pale gray-blue training robe with a short fitted inner sleeve, narrow belt, asymmetrical shoulder wrap and visible cloth thickness at cuff and hem.
Material and color system: matte silk-cotton, pale blue-gray, ink-black belt, small jade green accent, no glossy white immortal robe.
Supporting light: cool dawn side light with one warm jade bounce under the chin, revealing cheek planes and hand tendons without beauty glow.
Posture and gesture: standing three-quarter, one hand holding a half-cracked jade practice token at chest height, shoulders restrained, weight still deciding whether to step forward.
Simple scene pairing: simple mountain sect stone step and a blank training gate behind him.
Usable-frame requirements: eyes, hands, costume, role prop and visible decision must all be readable so this works as a future keyframe, not only a static design sheet.
Inherit: clean bone structure, restrained youth, robe layers, jade token, decision pressure.
Do not inherit: generic white-robed xianxia idol, web-influencer face, random aura, ornate palace background.
Aesthetic peak requirements: this must be an attractive, specific, role-readable Chinese character frame; the viewer should understand age, class, personality pressure, cultural root and role function without reading text.
Failure requirements: no default LLM face, no generic costume portrait, no web-influencer face, no identical old-man template, no identical middle-aged official template, no ordinary protagonist turned villain, no caricatured Chinese face, no shapeless robe, no random glowing luxury, no unreadable role object, no watermark.

entries.title: 青铜礼制疑局
entries.text:
Create one wide 16:9 Chinese 2D animated feature keyframe. Pure 2D animation only; it must not look like live-action, CG, thick concept art, oil painting, game splash art, or a poster.
Visual style: bronze ritual order direction: ranked bodies, altar geometry, bronze vessel logic, oracle-bone fracture shapes, cinnabar-black pressure and a divine shape readable through tide-light, smoke and reflected metal.
Story beat: inside a torchlit bronze archive, a young ritual officer hides a cracked oracle bone under his sleeve while an armored commander silently notices the reflection in the bronze vessel; both hands freeze before either one speaks.
Single-frame event contract: the ritual officer conceals evidence, the commander notices it only through the bronze reflection, and both hands stop one beat before breaking ritual order.
Aesthetic peak requirements: make this an unforgettable single frame with a clear visual hook, one irreversible moment, readable event, strong foreground/midground/background hierarchy, and a main silhouette that can stand alone without a title.
Drama performance requirements: this must read as acting, not atmosphere. Show gaze target, micro-expression, hand hesitation, body weight, private motive, and the object or threshold that carries the unsaid decision.
2D animation requirements: visible clean line hierarchy, graphic silhouettes, flat designed color shapes, limited cel-shaded shadow blocks, non-photographic faces, simplified expressive hands, separated animation layers, no realistic skin pores.
Color-script requirements: cinnabar red and black bronze dominate, one cold sea-green light shape cuts the vessel rim, shadows are large flat blocks, no muddy brown realism.
Failure requirements: no readable text, no literal IP label, no photographic depth of field, no 3D render look, no oil-paint smearing, no adult-realistic concept-art faces, no glossy HDR poster glow, no watermark.

entries.title: 泥泞盾线救援 · 写实
entries.text:

Action requirements: show camera rhythm through body distance, hand pressure, object or weapon axis, weight shift, foot pressure and the next beat. The action must reveal character and physical cost, not a pose.
Cinematography requirements: photographed film-frame logic with camera height, lens focal length, blocking axis, real lens perspective, practical set construction, real skin response and aged cloth, wood, mud, bronze or stone material response.
Lighting plan: storm battle contrast, cool overcast sky at about 6500K from above, warm torch or burning cart edge at about 2800K behind the shield line, black mud and armor shadows remain dark with bright wet rims
Failure requirements: no anime face, no 3D cartoon body, no painterly brush finish, no oily HDR sheen, no glossy poster glow, no repeated texture filler, no decorative frame without real foreground occlusion, no text, no watermark.

entries.title: 泥战近身搏杀 · CG
entries.text:
Create one high-end CG animated feature film keyframe, physically based materials, stylized but weighty body mechanics, cinematic lighting for a Chinese guofeng visual-direction focus.
Cultural setting: 三国 - wartime mud, lamellar armor, banners, heroic exhaustion, survival under collapsing order.
Scene type: 动作戏. Visual style: 战争武侠 / 乱世搏杀.
Location: broken battlefield ditch beside a torn command banner.
Subjects: a female military scout with a short blade; a mud-covered heavy infantry officer forcing a counter-grip with a pole weapon.
Frozen moment: both bodies collide at knee height; survival is decided by leverage, not elegance.
Blocking and camera: low oblique camera almost at ditch level, armor plates and mud splashes cut across the lens, banner diagonal shows collapsing order. The camera position must explain the viewer's relationship to danger, secrecy, ritual or order.
Lighting plan: storm daylight 6200K diffused from rear, intermittent fireline 2400K from far left, no frontal beauty fill. Keep contrast decisive: the dark side may stay dark, the bright edge may burn only where motivated.
Color and material history: mud-caked lamellar armor, soaked war cloth, chipped iron, wet leather ties, splintered banner pole. Materials must show age, moisture, smoke, pressure or use; do not use generic ultra-detailed texture.
Medium requirements: must keep readable volume and material response; no plastic mobile-game render, no over-smoothed toy surface.
Physical and narrative requirements: the main action, gaze, hand pressure, object ownership and next beat must be readable without captions.
Lighting failure requirements: no flat default AI light, no oily HDR sheen, no poster glow covering the action, no repeated texture pattern used as detail.
Cultural drift requirements: no polished palace fantasy, no clean cosplay armor, no western medieval battlefield.
Composition requirements: if using a frame-within-frame, the foreground frame must create real silhouette, shadow, depth or threat, not a decorative border.
